Dear Sofia,

Thank you for reaching out, and I'm sorry to hear that order SO-62115 arrived two days late and that one carton was crushed.

Here's what happens next:
1. I've logged the late delivery and the damaged carton against order SO-62115.
2. A member of our support team will review the case and follow up with you about the damaged carton — including replacement or compensation options, depending on the contents and condition.
3. If you have any photos of the crushed carton or a note about which items were affected, please send them along so we can resolve this faster.

You don't need to do anything else right now. We'll be in touch shortly.

Best regards,
Northwind Analytics Support
